raw.details:
Overview

Codearambh 2.0 is a 24-hour offline hackathon organized by the TechFusion Team, Department of Computer Science & Engineering, Hi-Tech Institute of Engineering & Technology (HIET), Ghaziabad, with support from the Institution’s Innovation Council (IIC) and Sunstone.

Official WhatsApp Group

Join the official WhatsApp group for registration updates, announcements, important instructions and event communication:

https://chat.whatsapp.com/HR09HaxGTWmBiOKdAvwsg4

The hackathon welcomes students from HIET as well as participants from other colleges/institutions to collaborate, innovate, and build impactful technology solutions in a competitive and engaging environment.

PPT TEMPLATE:
https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1EOs74iybBU2cr2qRKrD6VKfIdGxydTDZ/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=110001097703440686415&rtpof=true&sd=true

Event Highlights

  • 24-Hour Completely Offline Hackathon
  • Team Size: 2–4 Members
  • Competitive project evaluation and prizes
  • Mentorship from faculty, industry professionals and experts
  • Internship opportunities for winners and top-performing teams, subject to applicable arrangements
  • Six domains: AI/ML, EdTech, Healthcare & Wellness, Agriculture & Sustainability, Travel & Smart Tourism, and Open Innovation
  • Three-stage evaluation: Idea → Prototype → Final Presentation
  • Certificates for eligible participants and winners
  • Food, refreshments and participant welcome kits
  • Industry interaction, networking and innovation opportunities
  • Unique Spooky Halloween-themed hackathon experience

Important Dates

  • Hackathon: 23–24 October 2026
  • Mode: Completely Offline
  • Venue: Hi-Tech Institute of Engineering & Technology, Ghaziabad
  • Registration Start: 14 September 2026
  • Registration End: 30 September 2026

Innovate • Collaborate • Build • Win

Dare to Code. Dare to Create.
